items.title: Refactor System Templates to Use Layout Containers
items.description: Refactor all 11 system templates (Classic Light, Classic Dark, Vercel Minimal, Vercel Professional, Vercel Executive, Vercel Modern, Vercel Classic, Dark Noir, Midnight Blue, Carbon Terminal, Obsidian Elegance) from absolute positioning to use layout_container elements with column/row layouts. The visual design must remain identical - only the underlying structure changes to use the container-based layout system.
acceptance_criteria: All 11 system templates use layout_container elements instead of absolute positioning
Column containers are used for vertically stacked sections (header, billing info, tables, footer)
Row containers are used for side-by-side elements (Title+From, BillTo+Dates, Notes+Summary)
Child elements use positionMode: 'relative' with parentId references
Visual output is pixel-perfect identical to original templates
PDF export produces identical output
Table visibility toggles work correctly (work hours show/hide)
Empty containers collapse properly when showWhenEmpty: false
All token interpolation ({{invoice_number}}, etc.) works correctly
Style editor displays containers correctly
steps_to_verify: Generate PDF screenshots of all templates BEFORE refactoring
Refactor Classic Light template first as reference implementation
Compare visual output - must be identical
Refactor remaining 10 templates using same pattern
Test each template: PDF export, visibility toggles, token interpolation
Verify style editor shows containers with proper hierarchy
Screenshot comparison: BEFORE vs AFTER must match

items.title: Restore Original Templates and Add V2 Container-Based Variants
items.description: The container-based template refactor (STYLE-001) introduced rendering issues where elements stack/overlap instead of displaying correctly. Instead of fixing the broken templates, restore the original 11 working templates (absolute positioning) and keep the new container-based templates as separate 'V2' variants for future iteration.
acceptance_criteria: All 11 original templates (absolute positioning) are restored from before commit 9556561
Original templates render correctly in style editor (no stacking/overlapping)
Original templates export to PDF with correct layout
New container-based templates renamed with 'V2' suffix (e.g., 'Classic Light V2')
New V2 template IDs use 'v2' suffix (e.g., 'system-classic-light-v2')
Total of 22 system templates: 11 Classic + 11 V2
steps_to_verify: Retrieve original templates from git: git show 9556561~1:apps/web/src/lib/system-templates.ts
Copy original 11 templates to system-templates.ts
Rename existing container-based templates with 'V2' suffix in name and ID
Open each original template in style editor - verify correct rendering
Export each original template as PDF - verify correct layout
Verify V2 templates are listed separately from originals

items.title: Implement Folder-Based Template Organization with Modal Navigation
items.description: Replace the flat grid of system templates with a folder-based UI. Display two clickable folder cards with folder icons and names below: 'Default Styles Classic' (11 templates without -v2 suffix) and 'Default Styles V2' (11 templates with -v2 suffix). Clicking a folder opens a shadcn Dialog modal popup showing the templates inside that folder.
acceptance_criteria: StyleFolder component created with folder icon (lucide-react Folder/FolderOpen)
Folder card displays folder name below the icon
Folder card shows template count badge
Two folders displayed in 2-column grid: 'Default Styles Classic' and 'Default Styles V2'
Classic folder contains 11 templates (IDs without '-v2' suffix)
V2 folder contains 11 templates (IDs with '-v2' suffix)
StyleFolderContentsDialog component created using shadcn Dialog
Clicking folder opens modal popup showing templates inside
Templates displayed in modal using existing StylePreviewCard component
Selecting template from modal closes dialogs and triggers export
Folder icon changes from Folder to FolderOpen on hover
Existing 'Classic Styles' section (Light/Dark buttons) remains unchanged
Existing 'Custom Styles' section remains unchanged
steps_to_verify: Create StyleFolder.tsx component in apps/web/src/components/export/
Create StyleFolderContentsDialog.tsx component in apps/web/src/components/export/
Modify StylePickerDialog.tsx to filter templates by '-v2' suffix
Add folder state management (selectedFolder, folderDialogOpen)
Replace flat template grid with two StyleFolder components
Run npm run dev and open export dialog
Verify two folder cards appear in Default Styles section
Click 'Default Styles Classic' folder - verify modal opens with 11 templates
Click 'Default Styles V2' folder - verify modal opens with 11 templates
Select a template from folder modal - verify PDF export works
Verify Classic Styles and Custom Styles sections still function
